def raster_line(p1, p2):
    """Generate pixels along line from p1 to p2 using Bresenham-like approach"""
    x1, y1 = p1
    x2, y2 = p2
    dx = abs(x2 - x1)
    dy = abs(y2 - y1)
    sx = 1 if x1 < x2 else -1
    sy = 1 if y1 < y2 else -1

        yield (x1, y1)
        if x1 == x2 and y1 == y2:

        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:

            x1 += sx
        if e2 < dx:
